propositions: The helper must enumerate live origin heads and tags at runtime via git ls-remote, collapse annotated-tag ^{} peeled lines onto canonical refs, and record exact direct and peeled OIDs for every ref without hardcoding counts.

The helper must classify each enumerated commit ref with exactly one old-tip ancestry relationship (same, ancestor, descendant, diverged-with-merge-base, unrelated) and record non-commit refs without ancestry classification.

The helper must refuse partial or promisor clones, reject output paths inside the repository/Git directory/registered worktrees, and never overwrite pre-existing artifacts, exiting nonzero with a fresh-unfiltered-clone remedy.

The helper must create a git bundle from explicit temporary refs for the old tip and requested pins, verify it with git bundle verify, then restore it into a throwaway repository and confirm the restored OIDs exactly match the original names.

The helper must snapshot origin heads and tags before and after execution and refuse any remote mutation; caught verification failures must remove only the invocation's reclaim-backup namespace and owned artifacts without incomplete state.
